operations.name: techne-projector-endomorphism-purity-auditor
operations.description: Check projectors are stateless and idempotent, with no residual math or solver calls inside them.

operations.name: techne-run-tests
operations.description: Use to run project tests with coverage, check tests pass, or validate changes.

operations.name: techne-shared-corpus-custodian
operations.description: Use when touching _shared or _templates. Checks naming, size budgets, citations, dangling refs and parity.

operations.name: techne-silent-failure-hunter
operations.description: Find swallowed exceptions, naked unwrap and unhandled error fall-through in Python and Rust (ROP Result purity).

operations.name: techne-software-dev-manager
operations.description: Enforce Rust and Python parity and Clean Architecture; veto modules with under 95 percent coverage or drift.

operations.name: techne-software-qa-manager
operations.description: Run the QA gate chain. Test inspector veto, silent-skip detection, docstring audit, red team, repair loop.

operations.name: techne-sprint-devops-review
operations.description: Pre-retro sprint CI gate. local_ci.py, clippy, contract gates, registry integrity, claim IDs, Lean sorry scan.

operations.name: techne-sprint-execution
operations.description: Orchestrates agile sprint execution, task breakdown, burn-down tracking, and blocker escalation.

operations.name: techne-sprint-manager
operations.description: Coordinate the sprint lifecycle from planning to briefing with product, QA and specialist skills.

operations.name: techne-sprint-planning
operations.description: Guides sprint backlog grooming, capacity planning, ticket dependencies, and definition of done alignment.

operations.name: techne-sprint-planning-review
operations.description: Reviews sprint plans against engineering capacity, defect backlogs, and product roadmaps.

operations.name: techne-sprint-retrospective
operations.description: Executes sprint retrospective analysis, root cause audits of blockers, and continuous process improvements.

operations.name: techne-sprint-svp-briefing
operations.description: Escalate unmanageable sprint issues, firewall breaches and high risks (above 0.7) to the SVP of Engineering.

operations.name: techne-sprint-vp-briefing
operations.description: Brief the VP of Engineering on sprint delivery and risk for the next engineering council meeting.

operations.name: techne-stale-census-detector
operations.description: Find tests asserting a live corpus count equals a hard-coded integer, which fail as the estate grows.

operations.name: techne-svp
operations.description: Senior VP Engineering role. Collect escalations above risk 0.7, keep the escalation ledger, brief the council.

operations.name: techne-test-silent-skip-detector
operations.description: Flag tests that pass while checking nothing. Bare returns, skips on repo fixtures, tautological asserts.

operations.name: techne-uncalled-module-detector
operations.description: Find modules whose only importer is their own test, so they have no production caller.

operations.name: techne-unfalsifiable-gate-auditor
operations.description: Find acceptance criteria and gates no mutation could turn red, and report which epics name a falsifier.

operations.name: techne-vp
operations.description: VP Engineering role. Sprint briefings, engineering risk assessment, delivery checks, escalation above risk 0.7.

operations.name: thanatos-adversarial-receipt-audit
operations.description: Audit receipts adversarially for semantic lies, un-recomputed bindings and evidence that does not match the claim.

operations.name: thanatos-aegidion-network-security
operations.description: Audit containment and network security; check no ambient network sockets in perception bureaus.

operations.name: thanatos-anti-dime
operations.description: Review engagement outputs (quick-start cards, notebooks, figures, claim maps) and cut slop, overclaims and hype.

operations.name: thanatos-append-only-log-truncation-auditor
operations.description: Check append-only ledgers record head entries (count and last digest) and tests reject tail truncation.

operations.name: thanatos-countermeasure-binding-repair
operations.description: Use when a countermeasure reference must resolve. Closes the gap between corpus defense uids and the registry.

operations.name: thanatos-exploit-indicator-coverage
operations.description: Use when hardening the cognitive-warfare gate. Measure and close detection indicator coverage of the exploit catalog.

operations.name: thanatos-human-promotion-firewall
operations.description: Block agent promotion to PROMOTED. Agents emit review packets only; promotion needs explicit human author consent.

operations.name: thanatos-intelligence-officer
operations.description: Use to process intelligence. Ingests raw files from the recycle center, updates the manifest, refreshes search.

operations.name: thanatos-nemesis
operations.description: Sandboxed red-team and security remediation. Contain breaches and audit privilege escalation.

operations.name: thanatos-public-claim-bs-firewall
operations.description: Check public math posts keep Lean toy, mechanized and prose claims distinct; no toy sold as a paper theorem.

operations.name: thanatos-skill-security-spector
operations.description: Scan external skills, tool definitions and commands for prompt injection, remote exec, sockets and credential leaks.

operations.name: theoria-rgb-public-math-post-gate
operations.description: Gate a public math post through ROI, Lean export, dialect, claim and voice checks to ACCEPT or REJECT.

operations.name: woland
operations.description: Repository Single Point of Entry (SPOE) for swarms (save for the paper swarm). Run the mandatory 22-role Retinue through one tested coordinator; every model contribution uses PFP. Use actual host tools, bounded repair and source-bound learning.

operations.name: woland-assigned-outcome-rule
operations.description: Count all assigned task outcomes.

operations.name: woland-check-sensitivity-pattern
operations.description: Bind a check.

operations.name: woland-claim-audit
operations.description: Audit a typed claim against declared evidence scope with a replayed Woland falsifier before reporting it.

operations.name: woland-digests
operations.description: Digest old files into useful code and agent contracts; carry applicable lessons and unresolved work into the next brief.

operations.name: woland-fixture-transport-block-then-later-seat-blocked
operations.description: Hella blocked by FIXTURE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE predicts a later seat (bezdomny) blocked the same way

operations.name: woland-free-information-pattern
operations.description: Check admitted information before queries.

operations.name: woland-hermetic-task-audit
operations.description: Audit Woland runs and teamwork packages for hermetic task execution, zero evidence borrowing across tasks, and strict input schema enforcement.

operations.name: woland-input-coercion-antibody
operations.description: Use a prompt-attached candidate to review silent structured-input coercion with a benign control.

operations.name: woland-native-gate-unavailable-then-native-gates-fail
operations.description: Native gate unavailable (blocked) predicts native gates still not all pass on later re-execution

operations.name: woland-parser-work-antibody
operations.description: Review exact parser work bounds.

operations.name: woland-parser-work-antipattern
operations.description: Reject syntax before costly parsing.

operations.name: woland-proof-premise-rule
operations.description: Carry used premises.

operations.name: woland-proof-scope-rule
operations.description: Keep formal conclusions within proved scope.

operations.name: woland-provider-http-400-then-native-gates-fail
operations.description: A seat blocked by PROVIDER_HTTP_400 is followed by native gates that do not all pass.

operations.name: woland-scope-falsifier
operations.description: Detect claim scope exceeding declared evidence scope at PRE_SEAL with a finite executable predicate and benign controls.

operations.name: woland-scoped-reuse-pattern
operations.description: Reuse unchanged evidence with its original scope.

operations.name: woland-silent-coercion-antipattern
operations.description: Find malformed workflow inputs silently wrapped or filtered into valid-looking steps.

operations.name: woland-stale-task-antibody
operations.description: Check learned guards against the current task.

operations.name: woland-strict-input-pattern
operations.description: Repair structured ingress with explicit typed refusals while preserving valid normalization.

operations.name: woland-typed-answer-rule
operations.description: Review exact task bindings, full typed answers and nested result snapshots.
